Container.Name: hopwatch
Container.Overview:
Hopwatch Probe pings your targets every second, keeps the history (every ping for days, minute and 5-minute averages for months) and runs MTR on demand, on a schedule, or automatically when a target goes down, loses packets or slows down. Every result can be copied for a support ticket or exported as an evidence pack.
Hopwatch Hub shows several probes on one page and tells problems several sites see at the same moment (the target's side) from problems only one site sees (that site's path or its own uplink). Turn it on in the same container with "Run the hub"; the local probe shows up in it by itself.
Everything else is set in the web UI. Host network is recommended so MTR shows your real first hop.

Config.Name: Run the probe
Config.Description: Ping and MTR from this server.

Config.Name: Probe web UI port
Config.Description: With host network this is the port on the server. If you change it, also change the WebUI link under Advanced.

Config.Name: Run the hub
Config.Description: One page for several probes. Usually on one server only.

Config.Name: Hub web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the hub web UI (only used when the hub runs).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Probe settings, ping history and MTR results (about 250 MB a year for 50 targets); hub settings in the hub subfolder.

Config.Name: Reset admin password
Config.Description: true removes the admin password at the next start, so you can set a new one. Switch it back to false afterwards.
